thread:
elaine: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem on the cloud-auth + model-registry flake — capturing action items, owners, and timelines. Please confirm or update.

raj: Thanks. Tracker created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421 — I'll consolidate all related tasks under INF-3421 and add tags.

maria: I'll own the model-registry fallback work (hot-cache + S3 artifact fallback). Plan: design doc this week, PR next, ETA 2026-04-12. Adding runbook entry.

sam: I can take vendor escalation & SLA review for AuthProvider. Will draft an escalation checklist and updated retry/backoff policy. ETA 2026-04-20.

security: Recommend adding short-lived service credentials + automated rotation to reduce blast radius. I'll produce a short threat-model + remediation list by 2026-04-05.

raj: Quick pattern note — we had 2 auth blips and 1 model-registry degradation in the last 90 days. Suggest we add a monthly dependency health review and a lightweight retro for repeated vendors.

maria: Minimal runnable runbook snippet I'm adding to INF-3421 now; includes automatic switch to cached model and notification to oncall. Snippet:```
# fallback order
1) live model (model-registry)
2) local hot-cache
3) S3 artifact (read-only)
4) degrade to smaller quantized model
```

sam: FYI — scheduled vendor sync with AuthProvider Monday 09:00 PST. Invite sent to @raj and @security. Agenda: incident timeline, root causes, SLA improvements.

raj: Temporary mitigation I pushed to staging — automatic fallback to quantized variant when registry latency > 2s. Command used: `redwoodctl routes apply --model-fallback=quantized-v1 --threshold=2000` — smoke-tested.

elaine: Please mark tasks with tag `postmortem:vendor-dep` and add ETA in Jira comments. We'll review in the weekly ops retro. :thumbsup:

ops: Added alert INF-MR-01: model-registry error rate > 0.5% for 5m -> page oncall. Added runbook link to alert.

maria: I'll also add a CI integration test that injects auth-provider latency (500ms+) so we can catch regressions in the future. Working on PR today.

ops-bot: runbook updated: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/model-registry-fallback (edited)

ops: Also added a recurring task: monthly dependency health-check (owner: raj). First run scheduled 2026-04-01.

sam: When vendor follow-up is done I'll propose contract language for retry/backoff + incident notification windows.

elaine: Owners — confirm here when you move the Jira card to IN PROGRESS. We'll close the loop in 2 weeks and add any follow-ups to the next retro. Thanks everyone.
